title: Super Princess Peach
subtitle: Peach goes to the rescue
summary: Super Princess Peach is Tose's Nintendo DS platform game starring the Mushroom Kingdom's princess. Bowser has used the Vibe Scepter to capture Mario, Luigi and their companions, leaving Peach to travel through Vibe Island and bring them home. body: Super Princess Peach is Tose's Nintendo DS platform game starring the Mushroom Kingdom's princess. Bowser has used the Vibe Scepter to capture Mario, Luigi and their companions, leaving Peach to travel through Vibe Island and bring them home. She carries Perry, a talking parasol that serves as a weapon, shield and adviser. The familiar rescue story changes hands, while the island's unusual emotional powers provide Peach with a set of actions suited to more than jumping between platforms and striking the next enemy.

Peach's Vibes transform emotions into practical abilities. Joy lets her rise through the air, Rage surrounds her with fire, Gloom produces flowing tears, and Calm restores health. Each consumes the Vibe Gauge, so a useful power cannot simply remain active throughout a level. The touchscreen makes the four choices accessible while the action continues. Their uses extend beyond fighting: tears can affect plants, for example, while flight changes which ledges can be reached. Choosing an emotion becomes a way to read the surroundings.

Perry can absorb enemies and help refill the energy needed for Peach's powers. Combat and exploration thus replenish the same small reserve, connecting an encounter to the next environmental obstacle. The adventure is organised into eight worlds containing ordinary stages and boss fights, with captured Toads hidden along the way. Searching for them gives a reason to inspect a route rather than only rush toward its exit. Peach's distinctive equipment and Vibes make the rescue an opportunity to explore another character's possibilities within a familiar platforming world.
